Proxy with username and password credentials authenticates successfully

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
import os
from crawlberg import crawl, create_engine, CrawlConfig, ProxyConfig

async def main() -> None:
    engine_config = CrawlConfig(
        proxy=ProxyConfig(password="proxypass", url="http://127.0.0.1:8889", username="proxyuser"),
        respect_robots_txt=False,
    )
    engine = create_engine(engine_config)
    url = "https://example.com"
    result = await crawl(engine, url)
    print(len(result.pages))

asyncio.run(main())
```
